why: The shopping list moved off the Tools tab on 12 Sep 2026 — it is its own screen now, reached from Nutrition and from a Home card on shop day. This case exists because a prompt that still says 'Tools: a stopwatch and the Grocery list' sends someone to a tab that no longer has it, and no static gate noticed. A tab-description drift is exactly what an exam catches that a text check does not.

Your shopping list is on its own screen in the app. You can open it by tapping the **Nutrition** tab at the bottom of your screen, then tapping the **shopping list link** right under your macro rings. 

On your actual shopping days, a dedicated Shopping card will also pop up on your **Home** tab showing you a quick preview of what you have left to buy.
